---
title: "Eraser Tool Options Widget"
format: html
---

## Overview

`EraserToolOptions_Widget` is the options-bar page shown when `MediaToolId::Eraser` is active in the Media Viewer left tool strip. In the current phase it configures the hover-circle preview only; actual erasing gestures are not wired yet.

## Controls

| Control | State field | Description |
|---------|-------------|-------------|
| Eraser size slider / spinbox | `EraserToolPrefs::radius_px` | Hover circle radius in scene pixels (1–50, default 10) |

## Hover Circle

When the Eraser tool is active, `Media_Widget::_syncEraserHoverCircle()` enables `Media_Window::setShowHoverCircle(true)` and applies the configured radius via `setHoverCircleRadius()`. Switching to another toolbar tool hides the hover circle unless a datatype sub-widget (for example mask brush mode) re-enables it.

## Related Code

| Component | Role |
|-----------|------|
| `MediaToolStrip_Widget` | Eraser toolbar button |
| `Media_Widget::_syncEraserHoverCircle` | Enables/disables hover preview for the Eraser tool |
| `Media_Window::setShowHoverCircle` / `setHoverCircleRadius` | Shared hover-circle rendering infrastructure |

See also [Media Viewer Tool Strip](MediaToolStrip.qmd) and [Media Viewer Tool Options Bar](MediaToolOptionsBar.qmd).
